name: Browser History Cleaner
description: Remove history for a selected domain. Disabled until database safety is rebuilt.
review_note: Review required: substring URL matching, live-database copy-back, and forced Edge termination. Use browser-native history controls in the meantime.

name: Cookie Cleaner
description: Allowlist-based cookie cleanup. Disabled pending domain and database-safety fixes.
review_note: Review required: naive last-two-label domain matching is incorrect for domains such as example.co.uk. Database backups and browser-closed checks are also required.

name: Lowercase Renamer
description: Recursive lowercase renaming. Disabled until collision-safe planning and rollback are implemented.
review_note: The existing script directly calls os.rename without collision protection. Preserve the script for refactoring; do not run it against valuable files.

name: Dual File Renamer
description: Match filenames across two folders using the existing desktop thumbnail interface.
review_note: Retained desktop tool. Selection currently triggers a rename; preview/confirm and undo are still needed.

name: Folder Compare
description: Compare filename stems across two folders in a desktop dialog; this is not a content comparison.
review_note: Non-recursive and extension-insensitive. Use Duplicate Finder for a content-based duplicate scan.

name: Base64 / PDF to PNG
description: Convert an image, PDF, or Base64 input to PNG with explicit input and output parameters.
review_note: The launcher now supplies the required input argument. Output filenames may overwrite existing PNGs; choose a new output directory.

name: Prompt Creator
description: Launch the existing KoboldCpp-connected prompt editor in its own local web interface.
review_note: Retained external service. It currently targets KoboldCpp, not a general GGUF runtime. CORS and endpoint configuration require a separate review.

name: Lyrics Embedder
description: Fetch provider lyrics and embed audio tags. Optional paid AI recovery is off by default.
review_note: Existing provider logic is retained. Provider health, tag backups, and rate limits still need integration testing. Advanced flags remain available in the script CLI.

name: CSV Workbench
description: Preview and convert CSV locally, including quoted multiline fields and escaped quotes.

name: Media Harvester
description: Preview or download media you are authorized to access, with structured controls and tracked jobs.
review_note: Preview is the default. Install optional yt-dlp/Playwright and system ffmpeg separately as needed. No automatic dependency installation occurs at launch.

name: Passive Media Capture
description: Run the existing passive capture script as a tracked job. Capture only content you are authorized to use.
review_note: Promoted from a hidden supporting script to a catalog entry. Browser binaries and download backends require local setup.
